notes.title: 10/25 Update + Russian Localization!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! It's been a while since the last game update (we are far more active and informative on the [url=https://discord.com/invite/Xzprjvn3u8]Gensokyo Odyssey Discord server[/url]) and I've come with a lot of news regarding the game.

First off, the game update itself. This update is v2.0 and includes quite a large amount of changes.

[list]
[*] Subtitles added to all the cutscenes, you can turn them on in the Preferences menu

[*] 3 new achievements in the fights

[*] A new "overtime" phase has been added to the secret boss, giving an alternate way to defeat them

[*] Dialogue has been added to Kakkoi's boss fight (MORE LORE!! YAHOOO!!!!)

[*] Resolution now defaults to whatever resolution you'd like to set it to

[*] New dialogue has been added to the Blackjack Minigame

[*] Fixed a softlock when playing Blackjack immediately after beating the game for the first time

[*] Bug fixes on some fights

[*] A few more QoL additions that I forgot to mention
[/list]

This update also introduces the Russian localization of the game! For the first time since the game's release, people who aren't fluent in English can enjoy the game. This is the first of what I hope to be many translations of the game. People from all over the world deserve the chance to be able to enjoy the game, so if you'd like to localize the game for your language, feel free to contact us at gensokyoodyssey@gmail.com



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41786302/0858ae864531acf45ecc92429cdc47a3b5a60fe4.png[/img]

In other news, I'll be adding a new post-game minigame, Kakkoi's Money Laundromat. This has been mentioned on the Gensokyo Odyssey discord server and is more frequently discussed there.

[i]Kakkoi went and gambled all her money on blackjack. Idiot. What better way to get her money back than to "take back" what's rightfully hers, in the form of a daring robbery? Or two? Or ten? Or as many as it takes to get it all back? With a little style, a little cunning, and a lot of adrenaline, Kakkoi... wait, if people see her robbing again they might remember her, and the police most certainly will if she gets caught! That's right, we're gonna let Okuu, Kakkoi's trusty right-hand and muscle, do the robbing. After all, she likes blowing people up.
But with all that new hard-earned moola, you can't just go around town with bags of cash! Luckily, Kakkoi has the perfect solution: money laundering! Set up a few front businesses, open a casino or two (maybe even gamble your cash there!),  and voila - clean, legitimate money. Upgrade Okuu's heist skills by teaching her what and what not to do in robberies, persuade other characters and their businesses to join you via charisma or blackmail, pimp out your room, and watch your fortune grow. 

Just remember to keep your schemes discreet, because if the police catch on, it's game over!  Stay one step ahead of the law... and your own greed![/i]



I have a much larger content update planned after development on this is complete, so stay tuned. Other than that, have a good day and a happy Halloween in advance! (please dont scare the children with a kakkoi cosplay)



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41786302/37a4312d95fee02b8a84febfa75790d4cefb2838.png[/img]
Art by jongk_ok

notes.title: 7/21 Update
notes.content:
Hello, everyone. 

This week's update is meant to make some of the game's hardest fights (barring the secret boss) easier.

- In Yukari's second phase, Healing is doubled to 20 HP
- Hisoutensoku's damage is decreased
- In Kakkoi's first fight, the chances for her to steal MP is decreased
- Fixed a few text errors

Last time I spoke to you, I mentioned hypothetical major Kakkoi-related content in the future. In that time, I've heard from a few people directly that they would love to see more of her.  However, I'm not sure if that sentiment is shared by the majority of players, and I don't want to oversaturate or force Kakkoi onto those who aren't interested. I think it's important to show restraint and not overwhelm the community with too much Kakkoi content. I also have plans to translate the game for Spanish, Portuguese, and Russian speakers, and I would like to focus on that before delving into major new content.

That being said, if the demand is there and enough players are interested, I will definitely consider creating more content featuring Kakkoi in the game. I may start a poll on the game's [url=https://x.com/GensokyoOdyssey]Twitter Account[/url] regarding this in the near future, so please keep an eye out and let us know your thoughts.

In the meantime, please share the game with your friends. Your enthusiasm and feedback means a lot to me and helps me make each update better and more enjoyable for everyone. Thank you all once again for your continued support and stay tuned for more updates in the coming days.

notes.title: OST on Spotify + Game on Linux!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! 
I'm working on a very major update of the game
This update will include:

[list]
[*] Adding unique special minigames for most bosses
[*] Greatly expanding and refining post-game Blackjack
[*] Refining and adding to some cutscenes (including a cameo from a certain Walfas lover)
[*] Balancing some fights
[*] Adding more dialogue
[*] A reworking of the MP system
[*] Reworked volume slider
[*] Many bug fixes
[*] More leniency towards requirements for the Secret Boss route
[*] Making the game more speedrun/replay-friendly
[*] Post-game art gallery
[*] Much more!
[/list]


This update will go live on [b]Friday, June 7th at 2pm EST[/b]. If you are planning on playing or replaying the game, I suggest you do it then.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41786302/77461783ecb6bead113dbdb33e7060f6c0faabe9.png[/img]

The 64 song, 3 hour long soundtrack is now availably on Spotify and other streaming services!
It is also available on iTunes, Amazon Music, YouTube Music, Pandora, and many more. 
If you don't have any of these services, it's also available on my [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Yij_AwHNOYU]channel for free[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41786302/d083a7e6ad20040f5e8446ef6a35c49b02d21b9a.png[/img]

The overwhelming majority of Touhou games (and fangames) are only available on Windows. But, of course, not everyone uses Windows. All three operating systems have their advantages and disadvantages, and people choose them accordingly by preference. I don't see it fit to punish people for their preferences by gatekeeping this game for Window users only. I think that anyone who wants to play this game on Steam has every right to do so, regardless of operating system. This is why I've released a Linux port of the game. Gensokyo Odyssey is now available on all three possible OSs; Windows, Mac, and Linux/SteamOS, making Gensokyo Odyssey one of the only Touhou-related games to be available on all three.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41786302/e1d436586d6a4ed58f30ac11d41c4f2896c8210f.png[/img]

That's all I have right now, be ready for Friday!

notes.title: May 18th Address
notes.content:
Hi!
It's been a month since the release of Gensokyo Odyssey. I would like to thank everyone for the high praise the game has received this past month, which has greatly exceeded my expectations of audience reaction. I have poured years of work into this project, and it means everything to me that it has been so well-received. I want to thank all the players for your support and feedback, which have been extremely helpful in improving the game and making it even better.

I've recently finished a semester and now I am able to return to further refinement of the game.
We're working on adding:
- Adding unique special minigames for most of each boss
- Expanding post-game Blackjack
- Refining some cutscenes (including a cameo from a certain Walfas lover)
- Balancing some fights
- Adding more dialogue
- More leniency towards requirements for the Secret Boss route

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41786302/80b198feb44175597c5a0c98012cbc22f875a683.png[/img]

As for releasing the soundtrack on platforms like Spotify and other streaming services, I've received many questions regarding the status of this. I've been working towards release for over a month; well before the game's release. Unfortunately, in my pursuits I have been thoroughly convinced that many distributors do not provide service congruent to the demands of the public. Despite my efforts, it seems the time when the soundtrack releases is at the mercy and leisure of these distributors. As such, I cannot promise or provide an ETA. Rest assured that I will continue to strive for a timely release for the enjoyment of the people.

For the time being, the soundtrack is streamable on [url=https://kronington.bandcamp.com/album/gensokyo-odyssey-soundtrack]BandCamp[/url], playable on [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Yij_AwHNOYU]YouTube[/url], and downloadable on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1866350/Gensokyo_Odyssey_Soundtrack/]Steam[/url]. There may be more frequent updates on this matter on my Twitter page in the future.
https://twitter.com/Kronington



Thank you for your patience, and stay tuned!

notes.title: May 4 Update!
notes.content:
A minor update to the game before a major one next week,

- Puck movement is now set on a toggle; you only need to click your paddle once to start/stop moving it, rather than continually holding click down to move it
- In fights, you can now press L twice to reset
- Save system fixes
- Softlock fixes
- Minor fixes to the secret boss
- Kakkoi's arm is tired from throwing so many grenades; grenade speed nerfed

Stay tuned!
